observations: The overlay covers the full Georgia headline ink while retaining a separate, slightly higher native logical allocation for the Office baseline. The subtitle and each section have independent source-ink windows.

Three metric stacks, three numbered arguments, the ten-cell gate table and the decision band each retain their semantic ownership. Thin horizontal rules separate evidence blocks. No decorative connector, icon or raster owner has been introduced.

The reason-detail logical allocations move upward by eight body pixels after actual LibreOffice inspection. Their search windows remain fixed to the complete original two-line source text, including the exact $60k condition.

Four semantic groups describe the economic hypothesis, bounded-pilot reasoning, observable scale conditions and funding request. The native table owns its cells and no duplicate floating cell text is emitted.
The title, subtitle, body/section and decision text retain the shared 64, 32 and 28-pixel targets. All ten fitted text groups reach the authored size without an allocation-driven reduction.
